summary: MDA Space Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting Q2 2026 results via press release, including revenues of $498.6 million (up 33.6% YoY), adjusted EBITDA of $96.3 million, and backlog of $4.0 billion. The filing mentions agreements to acquire Blue Canyon Technologies and CLS but provides no deal terms, price, or structure. This is an earnings report, not a special-situation event. The acquisitions are noted only as part of strategic commentary, not as a formal acquisition filing. Thus, no special-situation categorization applies.
